channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Quem está na frente nas pesquisas para presidente, Lula ou Flávio? Veja últimos levantamentos
item.description: The BTG/Nexus and PoderData/AYA polls released on April 13, 2026, measure the presidential runoff between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), with margins of error of two points and 1.8 percentage points, respectively. The surveys show no clear frontrunner, keeping the race balanced.

item.title: Mulheres rejeitam mais a extrema direita e podem decidir o 2° turno no Brasil, diz pesquisador
item.description: After a first round favoring Flávio Bolsonaro over Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, political scientist Josué Medeiros notes the Brazilian far-right's consolidation phase, with women showing stronger rejection of this bloc and potentially swaying the runoff outcome.

item.title: Tatiana Farah: Ação de Kassio pode ser 'tiro no pé'; canal cresce pós-veto
item.description: Tatiana Farah assessed that Kassio Nunes Marques' decision to block the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel may strengthen Lula's social media mobilization. The analysis was presented on UOL News, highlighting the impact of this decision on the electoral scenario.

item.title: Em anúncio de pacote para MEIs, Lula diz que economia está "longe do ideal"
item.description: Lula announced a support package for individual entrepreneurs (MEIs), acknowledging the economy is still far from ideal, with GDP growth of 2.3%. Measures include debt forgiveness of R$12.6 billion, increased revenue limits, and Pix grants. The announcement comes 12 days before the second round of elections.

item.title: Lula anuncia Pix MEI, que prevê repasse de R$ 5 mil para microempreendedor
item.description: Lula announced the Pix MEI program, offering transfers of up to R$ 5,000 to micro-entrepreneurs, with R$ 5 billion allocated from 2027 to 2030. The initiative is part of the Prospera MEI package aimed at supporting the popular economy and renegotiating small business debts.

item.title: Nunes Marques ignora corregedor eleitoral, suspende canal de Lula e impõe condições para funcionar
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, suspended the decision of the electoral clerk Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva and maintained the suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' channel on WhatsApp, imposing conditions for its reactivation, such as communicating the channel address to the Electoral Justice. The measure was adopted after Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign filed a lawsuit for spreading fake news through the channel, which mobilizes over 4.2 million users. The AEED reported no false information posts on the channel but expressed concern about mass message dissemination before the second round.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: o que muda na conta de luz, nos combustíveis e na Petrobras
item.description: Lula and Flávio propose different strategies to reduce energy costs in Brazil. Lula advocates expanding state-owned enterprises and consumer protection policies, while Flávio suggests reducing subsidies and taxes, promoting private investments. Their proposals may impact electricity, fuel, and natural gas prices.

item.title: Após impasse judicial, campanha registra canal de WhatsApp 'Exército do Lula' no TSE
item.description: Lula's campaign officially registered the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel with the TSE after legal disputes. The tool faced controversies over alleged misinformation, according to Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign. With registration completed, Lula's team is now officially responsible for the channel's content.

item.title: Dados da Presidência confirmam reuniões de Vorcaro no Planalto com operador de esquema no governo Lula
item.description: Presidency data confirms banker Daniel Vorcaro attended at least two meetings at Planalto Palace accompanied by operator Júlio Cezar, linked to Minister Alexandre Padilha, in an alleged scheme of kickbacks to release funds from pension schemes during Lula's government. According to Vorcaro, the group planned to capture up to R$10 billion from Previ, Petros, and Postalis coffers, in exchange for R$1 billion in bribe payments, including a R$500,000 signal paid after formal authorization of Banco Master to operate in the funds. The plea bargain proposal was rejected by the Federal Police and the Attorney General's Office due to lack of political pressure.

item.title: Em pacote para MEIs, Lula anuncia perdão de dívida tributária, ‘Pix’ de R$ 5 mil e novo Desenrola
item.description: Twelve days before the runoff, Lula unveiled the Prospera MEI package, offering tax debt forgiveness, a R$5,000 Pix, and debt renegotiation for microentrepreneurs. These measures aim to attract voters during the 2026 electoral campaign.

item.title: Cueva leu 21 laudas e escreveu outras 13 em 4 minutos a favor de Lula
item.description: The Electoral General Counsel, Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, reviewed and signed a 13-page decision favoring President Lula in under 4 minutes, reversing the suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' channel ordered by TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques. Nunes Marques criticized Cueva for not awaiting the collegial opinion of the TSE, questioning the judge's prudence.

item.title: Saiba as medidas anunciadas pelo governo para microempreendedores
item.description: The federal government announced the Prospera MEI package, which includes debt forgiveness of R$12.6 billion for 3.6 million MEIs, bank renegotiation with 90% discounts, a Pix MEI funding line of R$5 billion, and an increase in the MEI revenue limit. The measures aim to reduce debt and stimulate the economy of microentrepreneurs, with some proposals requiring approval by the National Congress.

item.title: Lula entra na disputa com o bolsonarismo pela bandeira da 'prosperidade'
item.description: Lula announced a package of measures for individual micro-entrepreneurs at the Planalto Palace as a strategy to compete with the Bolsonarismo on the prosperity agenda and reverse the disadvantage against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro visita a su padre en prisión domiciliaria tras un veto de tres meses
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro visited his father, Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest after three months apart. The meeting takes place during the campaign for the 2026 presidential runoff election. Polls show a technical tie between Flávio and Lula.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lamenta morte de Netinho: "Um dos grandes nomes do axé"
item.description: Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) mourned the death of singer Netinho, calling him one of the great names of axé music. Netinho died from complications of non-Hodgkin lymphoma and had previously called for military intervention after the 2022 elections.

item.title: “Marcou gerações”: Flávio Bolsonaro lamenta morte de Netinho nas redes sociais
item.description: The singer Netinho, 60, died from non-Hodgkin's lymphoma. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) mourned the artist's death on social media, highlighting his contribution to axé music and political activism supporting Jair Bolsonaro. Netinho, a staunch Bolsonaro ally, participated in 2022 and 2023 protests, including events related to January 8th.

item.title: A avaliação ‘poliana’ de campanha de Lula após revés no primeiro turno
item.description: After Flávio Bolsonaro led the first round, Lula's campaign seeks to turn the unexpected result into mobilization, highlighting greater digital organization and street presence. Allies believe the setback may drive a positive reaction in the second round.

item.title: “Pressão da sociedade”, diz Lula após Flávio apoiar fim da escala 6 x 1
item.description: President Lula emphasized that the 6 x 1 escalator must end due to social pressure, thanking the PL for aligning with the government. Flávio Bolsonaro reversed his stance and supported the PEC, citing majority worker support but criticizing regulatory gaps in the proposal.

item.title: Flávio ironiza campanha de Lula: "Vão dizer que vou acabar com o Sol"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro mocked Lula's campaign, claiming fake news about him is spreading lies, such as ending aliens' rights. The statement comes amid legal proceedings at the TSE between the campaigns.

item.title: Meta nega operar para favorecer ou prejudicar candidatos nas eleições
item.description: Meta Group denied to the TSE that it operated its systems to favor or harm candidates in the 2026 elections, claiming that restrictions on Lula's content were global technical failures. The PT campaign filed a lawsuit with the TSE after denouncing disproportionate impact from these issues. The company emphasized it has no responsibility over algorithms and rejected favoritism accusations.

item.title: Um surpreendente ‘cabo eleitoral’ para Flávio Bolsonaro na disputa contra Lula
item.description: Robson Bonin accused the Supreme Federal Court of acting as a 'campaign marshal' for Flávio Bolsonaro by allowing the resumption of family visits to former President Jair Bolsonaro, benefiting his campaign against Lula. The decision by Minister Alexandre de Moraes raised criticisms for allegedly favoring bolsonarismo, reinforcing the narrative of political persecution against the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Entenda as regras que Nunes Marques impôs ao canal “Exército do Lula”
item.description: TSE president Minister Kassio Nunes Marques suspended the 'Exército do Lula' channel following a PL request, keeping the campaign frozen until regularization with the electoral court. The measure was justified by alleged unauthorized electoral propaganda and instructions encouraging automated engagement behavior.

item.title: Na reta final do 2º turno, governo lançará “Pix MEI” de até R$ 5.000
item.description: The federal government announced Pix MEI, a program that will provide up to R$5,000 directly to individual micro-entrepreneurs to boost their productive capacity, allocating R$5 billion in funds not classified as credit or loans. The announcement, made by Minister Paulo Pereira, is a promise for 2027, contingent on Lula's victory in the runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro, and will prioritize women entrepreneurs with lower revenues.

item.title: Crusoé: TSE é incapaz de distinguir real de fake
item.description: In an op-ed published by O Antagonista, federal deputy Pablo Crusoé (PT) criticized the Electoral Superior Court’s (TSE) ability to identify and remove fake content during elections. He argued that the TSE positioned itself as an arbiter capable of curbting disinformation, but failed to deliver, revealing structural weaknesses in electoral oversight. Crusoé’s stance highlights broader concerns about the credibility and effectiveness of Brazil’s electoral monitoring institutions.

item.title: Nunes Marques se reúne com campanhas de Lula e Flávio
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, meets with representatives from the campaigns of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in a closed meeting to seek collaboration between the teams. The 2026 electoral debate shows signs of strategic articulation even among competitors.

item.title: 'Exército de Lula' no WhatsApp: por que Nunes Marques suspendeu canal novamente
item.description: The TSE president ordered the temporary suspension of the 'Exército de Lula' WhatsApp channel, which can only resume after President Lula formally registers it as a campaign instrument. The decision came after a preliminary analysis that did not identify fake news in the channel's content, but reinforces the need for formalization of political communication.

item.title: Pesquisa eleitoral mostra o eleitor que pode decidir a disputa entre Flávio e Lula na reta final
item.description: New BTG/Nexus poll shows Flavio leading with 52% against Lula's 48%, while 92% of voters have already decided. The runoff outcome hinges on the 7% who may switch and non-voters from the first round, whose choices could be swayed by revelations about payments to Lula's institute and street demonstrations.

item.title: Marinho rebate PT e nega fim de benefícios sociais com Flávio
item.description: Rogério Marinho, campaign coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro, stated that social programs like Bolsa Família and Farmácia Popular will be maintained. He accused the PT of spreading fake news to create fear about the candidate's proposals.

item.title: Em decisão, Nunes Marques frisa despacho de corregedor em 'menos de quatro minutos' após petição
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques emphasized the swiftness of a TSE comptroller's ruling, issued in less than four minutes after a petition, to restore the 'Exército do Lula' channel, which had been suspended. The decision set conditions for the channel to resume operations.

item.title: Direita democrática foi engolida, e esquerda precisa se reinventar após 1º turno
item.description: The first round of the 2026 elections shows that the far-right is advancing and the PL is approaching hegemony, while the left resists electorally but remains structurally weakened. Traditional right-wing and center parties suffered devastating defeats, absorbed by a Bolsonarism claiming authenticity. The PT–PCdoB–PV federation grew modestly, but the PL jumped from 98 to 121 seats.

item.title: Ministros do TSE veem estratégia de Nunes Marques e Mendonça para ‘disfarçar’ derrotas
item.description: TSE ministers appointed by Bolsonaro, Nunes Marques and Mendonça, have been accused of manipulating decisions to favor Flávio Bolsonaro, overturning or modulating rulings that went against their interests when a contrary majority was formed. They adjust decisions to avoid defeats in the plenary, as seen in cases involving the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel and posts about the patron saint Nossa Senhora Aparecida.

item.title: Apoio do centrão deflagra corrida por possível ministério de Flávio, que avalia antecipar nomes
item.description: Support from center-right parties for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy has sparked a race for government positions, with potential ministries and influence being negotiated even before the final election results. The struggle for political power intensifies in the 2026 electoral scenario.

item.title: É chegada a hora de uma Advocacia Pública autônoma
item.description: The article advocates for the autonomy of the State Public Defense as an essential institution to Justice and the functioning of Brazilian democracy, highlighting the role of prosecutors in converting political decisions into legally safe acts. The 1988 Federal Constitution recognized Public Defense as part of the Brazilian State, alongside the Public Ministry and Public Defender's Office, with missions of judicial representation and legal advice to federative units. The text emphasizes the importance of the Public Ministry and State Public Defense in ensuring the legality and efficiency of government actions, reinforcing the need for autonomous institutions to consolidate Brazilian democracy.

item.title: Campanha avalia que atos dão fôlego a Lula e aposta na 6x1 para furar bolha
item.description: Lula's campaign assesses that recent protests gave momentum to the ticket but have not yet reached undecided or independent voters. Allies believe the approval of the PEC ending the 6×1 scale could help expand support. Despite grassroots mobilization, internal readings indicate the core base remains insulated within its existing support bubble.

item.title: Tanto Lula quanto Flávio vão precisar do apoio de Gilmar Mendes no STF para governar, diz constitucionalista
item.description: According to Rubens Glezer from FGV, both Lula and Flávio will need Gilmar Mendes' support at the STF to govern. The Court may make concessions to the future government to avoid minister impeachments.

item.title: Com liberação de Moraes, Flávio visita Jair Bolsonaro em casa após 90 dias
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized Flávio Bolsonaro to visit his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, after 90 days of prohibition. The meeting will take place in Brasília before Flávio's campaign events in São Paulo. Moraes kept the ban on electoral political acts during the meeting.

item.title: Em busca de ampliar eleitorado, Lula vai anunciar medidas para MEIs
item.description: The Lula government is preparing measures for individual micro-entrepreneurs (MEIs) and Simple National companies, including new credit lines and debt reduction, aiming to increase support from this segment before the second round. Among the proposals is the expansion of the turnover limit for MEI enrollment, which is stalled in the Chamber. The announcement seeks to bring the president closer to an electorate resistant to the PT.

item.title: Ministro de Lula já conversa com sucessor em eventual governo Flávio
item.description: A sensitive minister in Lula's administration has already started talks with a potential successor in a possible Flávio Bolsonaro government, according to a column. The contact aims to ensure a peaceful transition, driven by polling data.

item.title: 2º turno: canal pró-Lula e programa "mudo" de Flávio mantêm TSE sob pressão
item.description: In the final stretch of the runoff, the TSE faces pressure from both Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaigns. The court must rule on the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel while investigating the audio-less broadcast of Flávio's electoral program. Lula criticized the removal of André Janones' channel, accusing the TSE president of bias, while Flávio questioned alleged irregularities without naming direct culprits. Additionally, the TSE ordered the removal of a digitally manipulated video shared by Flávio's allies, linking a Chilean protest image to a pro-Lula event.

item.title: Flávio terá de equilibrar agro com EUA e China, diz Tereza Cristina
item.description: Tereza Cristina states that if elected, Flávio Bolsonaro will need to balance agricultural negotiations between China and the United States, considering Brazil's interests. She highlights China as the largest buyer of Brazilian agricultural products and the US as the world's largest market, suggesting that Flávio's government would follow a balancing policy similar to that of the Bolsonaro administration. Cristina also attributes recent trade tensions to Donald Trump's tariff policy.

item.title: TSE: Kassio se reúne com equipes de Flávio e Lula após batalha de decisões
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques scheduled a meeting with the campaign teams of Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to discuss judicial decisions and the suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel created by André Janones. The meeting aims to maintain calm before the October 25th election runoff.

item.title: O movimento contra o voto feminino – no Brasil e no mundo - O Assunto #1823
item.description: The podcast O Assunto discusses the anti-feminist movement seeking to restrict women's voting rights, focusing on ultra-conservative discourse in the US and its impact in Brazil. Guests analyze the ideological origins of this movement and its expression in Brazilian politics, particularly during elections. The debate includes criticism of conservative lawmakers and feminist resistance to rights setbacks.

item.title: Semana terá duas pesquisas eleitorais presidenciais para o 2º turno; veja quando saem Quaest e Datafolha
item.description: Two presidential election polls for the 2026 runoff will be released this week: Quaest on Wednesday (14th) and Datafolha on Thursday (15th). Quaest, commissioned by Globo and O Globo, interviews 2,154 people between October 10-13, with a margin of error of two percentage points. Datafolha, hired by Folha de S.Paulo, surveys 2,520 respondents between October 13-15, also with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Flávio pede que eleitores corram mais riscos nas redes sociais
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) urged supporters to post on social media despite possible profile bans, during a live broadcast 13 days before the runoff. His campaign judicially challenged the WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula', but the suspension was overturned by the electoral general counsel. The case involves André Janones (Rede-MG) and digital mobilizations from both sides of the electoral race.

item.title: Nunes Marques suspende jornal de sindicato favorável a Lula
item.description: TSE minister Kassio Nunes Marques ordered the suspension of a Sindipetro Unificado journal following pressure from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, which alleged irregular electoral propaganda funding in favor of Lula. The union had printed 30,000 copies with pro-Lula arguments, violating electoral laws. The ruling includes a fine of 10,000 BRL for non-compliance.

item.title: Programa de Flávio promete 'tesouraço' na censura enquanto pede bloqueio de perfis ligados a Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) government plan calls for a "scissors-cut on censorship," yet his campaign has been removing content from opponents on social media, including profiles linked to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The contrast between anti-censorship rhetoric and pre-campaign actions raises questions about freedom of expression and the strategic use of digital platforms.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro supera votos do pai em todas as rendas, e Lula cresce entre mais ricos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro received more votes than his father Jair Bolsonaro across all income brackets, while Lula lost votes in nearly all income segments, except the top 4% who showed growth. Lula's campaign shows disparate impacts in the voter base, with greater losses among the middle class.

item.title: Duda Salabert pede ao MP apuração de vídeo de Nikolas com crianças
item.description: Duda Salabert requested MP-MG to investigate Nikolas Ferreira's video featuring children criticizing Lula and electoral campaign. The children discuss public security and prices without evidence of corruption allegations. Duda questions production conditions and child protection.

item.title: Deputados do PT pedem ao STF investigação de Nunes Marques
item.description: PT lawmakers request STF investigation into Minister Kassio Nunes Marques over corruption, money laundering, and misconduct allegations, citing suspected ties to Banco Master. The filing includes messages and votes linking the judge and his associates to financial dealings involving the bank.

item.title: Site da Ancine sofre ataque hacker com mensagens contra Lula e ataques a nordestinos
item.description: The Ancine website was hacked on Monday afternoon, displaying political messages supporting Flávio Bolsonaro and opposing Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, along with attacks against Northeast residents and praise for the Southern region of Brazil, the US, and Israel. The content was removed and the site is temporarily offline.
